title: Pilger Tornado Security
description: Members of the Nebraska National Guard assist local authorities on June 18th as clean-up efforts begin following the June 16th twin tornados in Pilger, Nebraska.  Twenty soldiers are manning entry control points for 24-hour coverage, protecting from looters and assisting with traffic flow.
